part.name: Multi-block thermal/mechanical assembly (9 solids)
part.description: An assembly-like CAD model consisting of two main upper blocks (a left multi-port/manifold block and a right finned heat-sink style block), a lower mounting/bracket plate, an intermediate clamp/interface block, a central cylindrical tube/heatbreak element, and three nozzle/fastener subcomponents at the bottom (left/center/right). Visible functional features include multiple vertical bores/counterbores, side mounting holes, clamp bores/slots, stacked fin faces, and conical seating/chamfer transitions typical of nozzles and countersinks.
part.symmetry_note: No global symmetry; the three bottom nozzle/fastener elements repeat with similar geometry but are positioned at different X locations.

Section.name: Left manifold / port block
features included: Top face with multiple large circular bores/counterbores
Two large vertical flow/fastener bores (approx. at x=-50 and x=-30)
Bottom entry/seat chamfers for the bores
Outer rectangular envelope faces for mounting/contact
Section.function intent: Provide a rigid multi-port body (manifold) for mounting and routing interfaces (e.g., fasteners and/or flow paths) and to connect to the lower bracket.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a stiff compressive/shear load path between mounted interfaces and the bracket; large bores reduce mass and provide passage/fastener clearance while top/bottom counterbores create seating and alignment for mating parts.
Section.geometry: Block-like prism with chamfered/angled side facets; multiple large vertical cylindrical bores with counterbore/countersink transitions; planar top/bottom faces.
Section.location: Upper-left of assembly (negative X), roughly y in [-21,0], z in [0,25].

features included: Stacked parallel fin faces (multiple planar steps)
Two large vertical bores/counterbores (x~30 and x~50, y~-6)

Section.function intent: Provide a large surface-area body (fins) for heat rejection and a rigid mounting mass for the clamp/interface and fasteners/ports.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a stiff block carrying loads between clamp and bracket; fins increase external surface area for convection while preserving core stiffness.
Section.geometry: Rectangular prism with many repeated planar fin steps on one side; two large vertical bored features with conical transitions; planar top/bottom faces.
Section.location: Upper-right of assembly (positive X), roughly y in [-18,0], z in [0,30].

Section.name: Lower mounting/bracket plate
features included: Large planar top deck supporting upper blocks
Bottom planar base (below z=0 in this assembly)
Side walls and end faces (y=-30, y=-48 bounds)
Section.function intent: Provide the primary structural base to mount the upper blocks and to locate/support bottom nozzles/fasteners; also provides clearances and passages.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a stiff plate carrying bending and shear loads; distributes loads from attached blocks to mounting points; angled faces reduce stress risers and provide clearances.
Section.geometry: Plate-like body extending in X with end faces at y=-30 and y=-48; top at z~7.5 and bottom at z=-6; includes angled planes and a large cylindrical through/passage feature.
Section.location: Lower/mid assembly, mainly negative-Y region (y≈[-48,-30]) spanning X from about -57 to -23 and supporting interfaces toward the center.

Section.function intent: Provide a central guided passage and structural standoff/connection between upper and lower interfaces (e.g., guiding a filament/rod or separating thermal regions).
Section.physical behavior: Works mainly in compression/tension along its axis and as a guide surface (cylindrical constraint). Internal bore provides clearance/flow while outer cylinder locates within a mating bore.
Section.geometry: Cylindrical sleeve/shaft with internal bore and conical lead-ins; multiple stepped cylinders and planar end caps.
Section.location: Near assembly center in X, around y≈-40, spanning z roughly from near 0 to above 20.
